quotes.text: Each enabled field writes its copied values into a new Calendar event. Disabled fields do not contribute values. The retained draft remains available for retry.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For D332899 at revision 3e22f6ce2506a323aecd485c174f9dab1c3a0298, the AI assessment describes the field conversion loop as copying enabled-field values into a new Calendar event, excluding disabled fields, and retaining the draft for retry. This contract is useful when changing conversion or its comments. The AI reports passing conversion, disabled-row exclusion, and retention tests; this is reported evidence rather than independent verification. The proposed explanatory comment was not accepted.
title: Create Save converts enabled fields and retains the draft
